draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The claim concerns label-noise robustness at 10%, 20%, 30% noise with specific drop values (0.6, 1.3, 1.8). The research package contains only exp1 (original labels) and Table T1; no noise-perturbation experiments, no Table T2, and no drop values are supplied. The claim has no support in the package.
